objects.name: Analytic 2273
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a registry write to Windows autorun keys or an AutoPlay/AutoRun configuration change referencing a binary path that is not part of the authorized Industrial Control System (ICS) software inventory, particularly in combination with removable media insertion. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Windows Security Event ID 4663 (requires Object Access auditing and SACL on monitored paths): repeated ReadData/ListDirectory access across ICS data paths by an unapproved process/account

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Inventory of binaries legitimately authorized to be referenced by autorun/startup mechanisms on ICS hosts.
Time window correlating removable media insertion with a subsequent autorun configuration change.
